nodes.note: Grant project code CARES20DB, fund codes F033C, 1 ledger row(s). Unspent = budget $2,000,000 minus expended to date $1,732,930 (money on order but not yet paid still counts as unspent). This project also gets money from other lines: Reserve Balance (HUD - CPD - CDBG - CARES Act - Public Space Activations (14.218)), paid from COVID-19 Grant Fund: $2,077,671; Reserve Balance (HUD - CPD - CDBG - CARES Act - Lead Service Line Replacement (14.218)), paid from COVID-19 Grant Fund: $436,753. These are different pots of money, so nothing is counted twice. Each amount is the unspent part of one grant, so do not add them up as the project's cost.
